title: Golden trace catalog and drift detection workflow for analytics SLIs
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Problem: When SLIs change (new definitions, aggregation windows, or new service partitions), historical analytics traces and SLI time series no longer align with current expectations. This makes regression debugging and SLO drift diagnosis slow: engineers must re-run queries, reconstruct traces, or rely on ad-hoc exports.

Goal: Build a Golden Trace Catalog (GTC) and automated drift detection workflow that: 1) captures representative, high-quality traces (golden traces) for key journeys and SLI windows; 2) stores deterministic replay metadata to allow incremental re-computation of SLIs when definitions change; 3) runs nightly drift detection comparing current SLI measurements against replayed baselines and surfaces anomalies to oncall and PMs; 4) integrates with the Console dashboards for one-click replay and a curated searchable catalog by journey, tenant, and signature.

Scope: backend services and analytics pipelines only — generate & index golden traces, augment our replay-store metadata, extend nightly SLI backfill job, add drift detector pipeline, and expose minimal read endpoints for Console UX (catalog listings, replay triggers). We will NOT change client SDKs or sampling at-source in this ticket (those are follow-ups).
acceptance_criteria: Golden Trace Catalog service that accepts, validates and indexes trace artifacts with canonical metadata (journey, tenant, trace-signature, resource-cost-metrics)
Nightly replay job can deterministically re-compute SLI series for a configurable time window using golden traces and raw event store (replay reproducibility >= 99% for deterministic components)
Drift detector produces a ranked list of candidate regressions with signal, severity, and suggested root-cause buckets (latency spike, KV-cache-miss, sampling rate change)
Console endpoints return catalog entries and provide a replay token/URL that the UI team can consume (schema stable for console-2025.04 release)
End-to-end integration test that runs on CI against the replay harness and validates at least 3 golden trace journeys (chat generation path, embeddings ingestion path, dashboard aggregation path)
tasks: Design catalog schema and storage plan (hot index for last 30d, cold store for 1y) — RFC draft in Confluence
Extend trace ingestion worker to accept golden-trace flag and validate deterministic fields
Implement replay metadata writer in analytics pipeline (captures input event cursor ranges and transform versions)
Add a nightly backfill/replay controller job with retry/parallelization and budget-aware shard sizing
Build drift-detection microservice that ingests replayed SLI vs live SLI and computes statistical divergence and root-cause heuristics
Create lightweight read endpoints for Console: /gtc/list, /gtc/{id}/replay-token
Add CI integration test harness and sample golden traces for the three reference journeys
Prepare runbook and onboarding doc for SRE and analytics owners
comments: 2025-02-12 Aisha Kapoor: Initial ticket — raised during postmortem for incident INC-2025-013 where SLO drift was observed after an aggregation change. Proposed Golden Trace Catalog as deterministic source for replay-based SLI recomputation.

2025-02-18 Jordan Lee: PoC notes — prototyped replay metadata in a local harness using eventstore cursors; deterministic replay works for pure-transform paths but flaky for windows that rely on sampling. Next: capture transform hash and sampling seed when generating golden traces.

2025-02-25 Miguel Santos (review): Feedback — prefer storing compactified traces (trimmed KV cache pointers) to reduce index size. Suggest adding cost-metrics so catalog entries can be prioritized when storage budget is tight.
2025-03-03 Product review (Lina Martin): PM approved scope for console-2025.04; requested that Console UX team be consulted early for minimal endpoint shapes. Assigned UI contact: Priya Rao.

2025-03-05 Jordan Lee: Implementation plan committed — split work into two PRs: (1) ingestion + schema change, (2) replay & drift microservice. Opening RFC link and initial schema sketch in Confluence.
notes:
Trade-offs considered: storing full traces (largest storage but easiest replay) vs compactified traces plus sidecar metadata (smaller, slightly more complex replay). We chose compactified + deterministic metadata to balance cost and reproducibility.

Open questions: how to prioritize which journeys become golden traces (tenant-impact weighting vs. cost-to-recompute). Proposed heuristic: combine recent error-rate delta, tenant revenue tier, and trace cost to compute a score — iterate after first 90 days.

Follow-ups: Instrumentation changes to capture sampling seed at-source (future ticket), retention policy for golden traces beyond 1y, Console UX tickets for catalog browsing and single-click replay.
owner_notes: Jordan will own infra changes; Aisha will coordinate drift detector model heuristics with Research. SRE to review runbook before roll-out. Expect a beta release of the GTC on internal staging by 2025-04-10.
